need: Build a reference for a whole industry, where no single company's hierarchy is the backbone
what_we_did_instead: Built the backbone from peers' public structure and standards, with a decision per L0 to L2 node (DSBP-DEC-0005, 0012 to 0031)
proposed_change: Add an industry-reference mode: the backbone may be built from a standard plus 3 or more independent companies, each node decided by the owner; a seed hierarchy is a starting point only

need: An evidence order where standards drive the design and peers only validate it; the organization's own documents are not tier 1
what_we_did_instead: Recorded our own order (DSBP-DEC-0002)
proposed_change: For a reference ontology: 1. standards and sector bodies, 2. 3 or more independent companies' public disclosures, 3. sector-specific sources, 4. generic frameworks as crosswalk only. Private company material may show what exists but is never cited

need: Split what belongs in the reference from what belongs to a company
what_we_did_instead: Decided the split for measures and RACI (DSBP-DEC-0033)
proposed_change: State the two layers: the reference holds definitions, formulas, measure kinds, typical KPI candidates and typical RACI by generic role; a company specialization holds KPI designations with targets and owners, its role titles mapped to the generic roles, named assignments, internal systems and instances

need: Typical RACI by generic role, from public evidence, where no company RACI is the source
what_we_did_instead: Not yet built
proposed_change: Add rules for reference RACI: generic roles from an occupational standard (O*NET-SOC, ISCO-08) or 3 or more companies; each assignment cites its evidence; rule 8 (infer nothing from the hierarchy) still holds

need: Generalize an existing company release without losing anything
what_we_did_instead: Built checks V1 to V9: baseline hash manifest, migration map with one row per term, company-term register and check, new neutral IDs
proposed_change: Add a generalization path: immutable baseline, migration map with statuses, company-term register with a check that scans every text property, neutral IDs with old codes only in the map, a decision per top-level node

need: Name only public off-the-shelf products, as labelled examples of generic system categories
what_we_did_instead: Decided it (DSBP-DEC-0006, 0034)
proposed_change: Add the rule: a system concept is a generic capability; products appear only as labelled examples cited to a public vendor page; internal systems never

need: Completeness: a seed release is not the boundary; each area is completed from external evidence and marked complete in a coverage table
what_we_did_instead: Decided it (DSBP-DEC-0008, 0032)
proposed_change: Add a coverage check to Step 8: a coverage table per area, each new item with an evidence class, and the owner's approval before an area is marked complete

need: A broad, maintained list of standards, vocabulary guidelines, metadata schemas, reusable vocabularies, registries and tools to check the Step 0 survey against
what_we_did_instead: Owner supplied the full text (2026-11-24); compared in research/sources/talisman-catalog-comparison-2026-11-24.md: 78 of 263 entries already in the skill, the relevant rest logged as SG-15 to SG-19
proposed_change: Add the catalog as a further-reading pointer in SOURCES.md and as a cross-check list in external-ontologies.md; cite each resource from its own publisher, not from the catalog; also add the Research Data Alliance Metadata Standards Directory, BioPortal and the W3C SKOS Datasets wiki to the registries to search

need: Registry search instructions that work today
what_we_did_instead: Found working endpoints by trial on 2026-11-24: LOV's documented API path returns 404 and its page search showed no results for 7 of 8 terms; BARTOC's /api/voc?search= ignores the term; Open Knowledge Graphs' search runs in the browser and its API was degraded; Archivo has no keyword search
proposed_change: Update the table: LOV /dataset/api/v2/vocabulary/search and /term/search; BARTOC /api/voc/suggest?search=; Open Knowledge Graphs api.openknowledgegraphs.com/ontologies?q=; Archivo, filter the full list. Add: a substring match is not a hit, and a multi-word query needs an exact-phrase check

need: A registry the build's own network blocks, not only an offline one
what_we_did_instead: Ran the searches from the owner's computer
proposed_change: Say that a search may run on another machine, and record where it ran

need: Review rules for candidate relations such as "enables" mined from documents
what_we_did_instead: Derived five rules from the 1.2 Step 4 review file: an enables that restates an output dependency is merged; one that hides a sequence becomes precedes; child-to-ancestor is part-of, rejected; same-parent links are stronger evidence; explicit text reference outranks structural nearness
proposed_change: Add these as generic review rules for any mined relation, with the evidence level each gives

need: A rule that step-order links between sibling steps are company practice, not industry fact
what_we_did_instead: Marked the 155 sibling precedes chains as examples or drops unless a public standard shows the order
proposed_change: Say that a reference ontology keeps an order only where a standard states it (APQC says its numbering implies none)

need: Migration checks that cover relationship facts, and that find subtrees by parent links
what_we_did_instead: Noted that check V2 must re-point all 640 facts, and that code prefixes misplace nodes moved earlier
proposed_change: Add: the identity migration test covers every fact's two ends, and no script locates a subtree by code prefix

need: A pattern for composing a measure from other measures (numerator, denominator, addend and so on), with checks
what_we_did_instead: Drafted research/modules/kpi-design/measure-composition.md from ISO 22400-2, KPIOnto and dbt MetricFlow
proposed_change: Add a measure-composition pattern: qualified component link with a role, a shortcut property, no executable formula, and checks (one numerator and denominator per ratio, no cycles, base measures have no parts)

need: Ontology quality scanners beyond qSKOS
what_we_did_instead: Listed OOPS!, FOOPS!/O'FAIRe, Skosify and SKOS-Utils from the catalogue comparison
proposed_change: Add them as optional Step 9 quality checks, each cited to its publisher, with when to run them

need: SKOS extensions for classification levels and label provenance
what_we_did_instead: Noted XKOS, ISO-THES and SKOS-XL
proposed_change: Say when to use XKOS (levels of a classification), ISO-THES (thesaurus arrays) and SKOS-XL (labels with their own metadata)

need: A deterministic graph form for diffs and checksums
what_we_did_instead: Noted W3C RDFC-1.0 (2024)
proposed_change: Canonicalize graphs with RDFC-1.0 before regression diffs and release checksums

need: A way to propose and score mappings before writing SSSOM rows
what_we_did_instead: Noted LogMap and the Ontology Alignment Evaluation Initiative
proposed_change: Add an optional alignment step: generate candidates with an aligner, review by hand, record only reviewed rows in SSSOM

need: A list of cross-industry vocabularies every Step 0 survey checks
what_we_did_instead: Listed SDMX, IFRS Accounting Taxonomy, UNSPSC, GS1 GPC, ESCO, ITIL/TOGAF, PKO, DCAT-AP/ADMS and CSVW
proposed_change: Add a cross-industry checklist to the survey step, each with its publisher and licence to read

need: A written vision (accept/resist policy) that delegated reviewers can judge changes against
what_we_did_instead: Used the external /vision skill (kunchenguid/vision, MIT), pointed at the build's own decision register and GOAL.md, and wrote ds_business_process/VISION.md because the repo root belongs to another release
proposed_change: Add a vision step before delegation: an evidence-mined accept/resist policy with non-goals, answered by the owner, that delegated reviewers cite
